description: Use when one question comes up mid-build ('keyed create', 'ifVersion', 'addressed', 'expand') and reading a full document would waste context. Searches the packaged guide and the API reference, offline (not the dashboard section `guide` reads live from docs.gemmein.com); returns matching passages with 3 lines of context either side, at most 6 match blocks per document. Not the tool for the fit verdict — search finds what the docs say, not what Gemmein refuses to support; call `guide` for that.
name: search_docs
title: Search docs
